purpose: Publishable reference-nutrition sidecar; distinct from exact-match primary values and feeding safety verdicts.

display_policy.verified_exact: Show verified exact part/state values first when available.
display_policy.related_part_reference: Show original numbers with an explicit analyzed-part and source notice; never label as leaf-only or exact-match.
display_policy.dry_matter_reference: Show only with dry-matter units; never mix with per-100g-fresh metrics.
display_policy.related_species_reference: Show exact species name and warn that species differ.
display_policy.upgrade: When exact part/state values are verified, promote only those to primary and retain these historical references.
display_policy.safety: Nutrition composition never determines tortoise feeding verdict.
display_policy.related_cultivar_reference: Show the cultivar name and warn that cultivars differ.
